question: Which of the following is known as the world’s wettest place?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Mawsynram**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mawsynram** is reported as the **world's wettest place** on earth.
 
• It is situated in **The Khasi Hills** in Meghalaya.
 
• It receives an **average rainfall of 11,872 millimeters**.
 
• The majority of its **rainfall is received** from the **Bay of Bengal**.
 
• People of these regions use grasses on the roofs to cover their huts from rain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meghalaya** is a North-Eastern state of India.
 
• It is famous for its **highest rainfall, biodiversity, and sub-tropical forests**.
 
• **Shillong** is the capital of the state.
 
• **Khasi, Jaintia, and Garo Hills** is an extension of the main Peninsular

 plateau.
